meta.title: Personal Memory MCP
meta.description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local Personal Memory service at http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp/. Uses a read-only client token from PERSONAL_MEMORY_MCP_DSH_TOKEN (or PERSONAL_MEMORY_DSH_TOKEN); no tools are added when the token is missing. Install and start Personal Memory first, then restart DSH so it inherits the token.
